artifact_type: candidate portable source-and-setup package installation validation

candidate_archive.build_command: .venv/bin/python scripts/build_portable_package.py --source-root "$PWD" --platform macos-arm64 --model-manifest handoff/MODEL_MANIFEST.json --qa-allowlist packaging/EMPTY_QA_ALLOWLIST.json --demo-db data/sightvault.sqlite3 --demo-data-root data --output "$PWD/.runtime/package-candidate/SightVault-macOS-arm64.zip"

demo_relocation.scope: Only the extracted candidate data directory was changed.

limitations: This validates the candidate source-and-setup archive, not a final release archive; parent UI/report changes may change later archives.
The archive is a portable source-and-setup bundle, not a native executable.
The shared model cache supplied the already pinned weights; this run did not test model download paths.
No Windows runtime validation was performed.

mac_setup.command: PYTHON_BIN=<native Python 3.12.9 base from unified .venv/pyvenv.cfg> HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 bash Setup-Mac.sh
mac_setup.dependency_install_network: PyPI dependency installation was allowed; model-weight downloads were not requested.

model_cache.location_description: Existing unified checkout .models directory, supplied through SIGHTVAULT_MODELS and --model-root; not part of the candidate package.
model_cache.recent_modified_file_check: No files under the unified .models tree had modification times within the post-run 15-minute check window.

offline_model_acceptance.application_network_guard: HF offline flags plus in-process non-loopback socket.connect guard; not an OS firewall
offline_model_acceptance.command: sandbox-exec <outbound-deny profile> env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 SIGHTVAULT_DEVICE=auto SIGHTVAULT_VISION=minicpm SIGHTVAULT_DATA=<extracted>/data SIGHTVAULT_MODELS=<unified checkout>/.models .venv/bin/python scripts/verify_offline.py --output <.runtime>/offline-real-model.json

retrieval_benchmark.command: sandbox-exec <outbound-deny profile> env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 SIGHTVAULT_DEVICE=auto SIGHTVAULT_VISION=minicpm SIGHTVAULT_DATA=<extracted>/data SIGHTVAULT_MODELS=<unified checkout>/.models .venv/bin/python scripts/benchmark.py --offline-check --output <.runtime>/public-demo-retrieval.json

database.source_folder: extracted candidate samples/ (path omitted from report)

superseded_candidate_attempt.failure: The packaged handoff/verify_transfer.py expected legacy handoff/PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json, absent from portable bundles which use PORTABLE_PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json.
superseded_candidate_attempt.resolution: verify_transfer.py now verifies the portable inventory when present and keeps the legacy immutable-extraction fallback; the rebuilt candidate passed 265/265 extracted-file checks.

system_memory_samples.scope_note: Whole-machine samples include unrelated host activity and cannot be attributed only to this candidate run.

unit_tests.command: sandbox-exec <outbound-deny profile> env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 SIGHTVAULT_DEVICE=auto SIGHTVAULT_VISION=minicpm SIGHTVAULT_DATA=<extracted>/data SIGHTVAULT_MODELS=<unified checkout>/.models .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests
